meta.title: Song Maker — make a song and shape its tracks
meta.description: Write a style and lyrics, generate a song with YuE2, separate its tracks, and work on the mix on your computer.

landing.headline: Turn your lyrics into a song.
landing.intro: Choose a style, write your lyrics, and run YuE2 on your computer. Then separate the song into tracks, adjust their levels, and work on the mix.
landing.localNote: Generation and audio processing run on your computer

mixer.ariaLabel: Interactive mixer for a song generated with Song Maker
mixer.title: Listen to the separated tracks
mixer.disclaimer: Song generated with YuE2. Six-track separation is experimental: guitar and piano are estimates and may contain bleed, especially piano.
mixer.error: This excerpt cannot be played right now.

facts.generation: YuE2 generates the song on your computer
facts.separation: HTDemucs separates the song into tracks
facts.privacy: Your projects and exports stay on your computer

process.title: A first version to make your own
process.intro: Start with your lyrics, generate a song, then listen to and adjust its tracks before exporting.

idea.title: Write your idea
idea.body: Describe the style you want and add your lyrics. Duration is a target; YuE2 does not guarantee an exact length.

generation.title: Generate a song
generation.body: YuE2 creates a stereo song on your computer. Generate a few versions and compare the results.

separation.title: Listen and make adjustments
separation.body: Separate the song with HTDemucs, adjust the tracks, then export your mix as WAV, FLAC, or MP3.

capabilities.title: Keep working on your song
capabilities.intro: Generate a starting point, add a part, compare versions, and adjust the mix in the app.

generation.title: YuE2 generation
generation.body: Create a take from a style and lyrics using models stored on your computer.

score.title: Score and piano roll
score.body: Import a MIDI file, edit its notes in the piano roll, and prepare the score for YuE2.

takes.title: Compare generations
takes.body: Run several generations in sequence and compare their audio to choose a version to develop.

instrumental.title: Instrumental part
instrumental.body: From Production: a track from tempo, key, and style (YuE2), or optionally from the mix/stems via ACE-Step Lego. Lego may return a fused mix, not a dry stem.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.body: Import several songs as JSON from the Library. Takes run on the GPU queue one at a time (admitted capacity: 1).

mix.title: Tracks and mix
mix.body: Separate tracks, edit clips, and adjust levels before exporting.

export.title: Audio exports
export.body: Export your mix as WAV, FLAC, or MP3.

setup.title: Song Maker runs on your computer.
setup.intro: Song Maker is a desktop app. Setup downloads the audio engine and models; leave disk space available and check that your GPU is supported.
setup.licenseNote: The CC BY-NC 4.0 license restricts commercial use of YuE2 weights. Read its terms before using them commercially.

stems.question: Which tracks can HTDemucs separate?
stems.answer: The standard model separates vocals, drums, bass, and other sounds. An experimental mode also estimates guitar and piano; both can contain bleed, especially piano.

local.question: Are my songs uploaded?
local.answer: Generation and audio processing in the main workflow use models installed on your computer. No account or online generation service is required.

hardware.question: What computer do I need?
hardware.answer: Generation uses a CUDA-compatible NVIDIA GPU on Windows and Linux, or Metal on Mac. The setup guide lists the requirements.

license.question: Can I use YuE2 in a commercial project?
license.answer: The YuE2/GGUF weights provided by the project use the CC BY-NC 4.0 license, which restricts commercial use. Read the license before using the weights in a commercial project.

batch.question: Can I generate several songs at once?
batch.answer: Yes: Library → Batch generation, from a JSON file. Takes run one at a time on the GPU queue (admitted capacity: 1). That is not two overlapping inferences.

closing.title: Check the requirements, then install Song Maker.
closing.body: The guide explains how to install the app, audio engine, and models.

hero.headline: Make a song, then work on its tracks.
hero.sentence: Describe a style, write your lyrics, and generate a song with YuE2. Separate the tracks, adjust the mix, and export from your computer.

promise.title: From your first lyric to an exported mix.
promise.body: Song Maker uses YuE2 to generate a song from a style and lyrics. HTDemucs then separates the tracks so you can adjust the mix and export the result.

features.title: Write, generate, and shape the result
features.body: Song Maker brings together YuE2 generation, score editing, track separation, and mixing.

yue2.title: YuE2 generation
yue2.body: Describe a style and add lyrics to generate a song with YuE2 on your computer.

score.title: MIDI · piano roll · ABC
score.body: Import MIDI files, edit notes, and prepare an ABC score for YuE2.

candidates.title: Compare versions
candidates.body: Run several generations and listen to them in the A/B comparator.

instrumental.title: Instrumental part
instrumental.body: Add a track from Production: YuE2 from the project, or opt-in ACE-Step Lego from the mix/stems. Lego does not claim a dry stem.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.body: Import a JSON song list in the Library. Exclusive GPU queue, admitted capacity 1.

stems.title: Track separation
stems.body: HTDemucs separates vocals, drums, bass, and other sounds. Experimental ONNX mode also estimates guitar and piano, with possible bleed.

mix.title: Editing and mixing
mix.body: Move clips and adjust the mix with the production tools in the app.

export.title: WAV / FLAC / MP3 export
export.body: Export your mix as WAV, FLAC, or MP3.

lora.title: Optional LoRA models
lora.body: The catalog shows each model’s license terms before download.

remote.title: Remote generation
remote.body: The remote generation control is a prototype: it queues work locally and sends no network request.

examples.title: Try the audio examples
examples.body: These synthetic sounds let you try the player controls. They were not generated with YuE2.

ab.title: Compare two versions
ab.meta: The second version changes after 2.5 seconds

gallery.title: How the process works
gallery.body: These illustrations explain the steps in Song Maker. They are not screenshots of the app.

license.title: About model licenses
license.body: The YuE2/GGUF weights use the CC BY-NC 4.0 license, which restricts commercial use. Song Maker remains a personal prototype: the models are not sold, and the project makes no claim of commercial use.
license.note: Optional LoRA models also show their license terms in the app.

gpu.q: What GPU do I need for generation?
gpu.a: An NVIDIA GPU on Windows/Linux (CUDA), or a Mac that supports Metal. Setup downloads the models separately.

suno.q: Does Song Maker work like Suno?
suno.a: Song Maker is a desktop app that generates and processes music on your computer. It also includes score editing, track separation, and mixing.

os.a: Windows and Linux x64 with NVIDIA/CUDA, plus Intel and Apple Silicon Macs with Metal. See the installation guide.

commercial.q: Can I use the songs commercially?
commercial.a: The YuE2/GGUF weights provided here use the CC BY-NC 4.0 license, which restricts commercial use. Check the license terms before using them.

cta.title: Install Song Maker on your computer.
cta.body: Download the app, then follow the guide to install the audio engine and YuE2 models.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.body: Setup, what’s new, making a first song, editing a score, mixing, and troubleshooting.

downloads.title: Download Song Maker
downloads.intro: Choose the version for your system. The audio engine and models download separately during setup.
downloads.whatsNew: New in v{version}: JSON batch import (GPU queue capacity 1), YuE2 instrumental part, opt-in ACE-Step Lego mix/stems add-track (fused mix possible), grid-snapped punch, FR/EN desktop UI.
